children.value: > Fact From Story Meta’s black-and-white policies often preclude it from effectively moderating any nuanced topic, like content that discusses violence without condoning it.
> > Fact From Story Advocacy groups have also raised concerns that Meta’s partnerships with government agencies, such as the Israeli Cyber Unit, politically influence the platform’s policy decisions.

> > > Fact From Story During the last violent outbreak between Hamas and Israel in 2021, a report commissioned by Meta and conducted by a third party concluded that the company’s actions had an “adverse human rights impact” on Palestinian users’ right to freedom of expression and political participation.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge An independent report is likely to show a company's true actions.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Partnerships with government agencies can lead to biased policy decisions.
> Commonsense Knowledge Policies that are too rigid may not properly address complex situations.
